activity_summary: At night you repeated James Burbage's sentence about a great stone hall in the Blackfriars that would hold a winter. You did not add a price, and you did not invent a second hall.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Repeated the sentence, and did not extend it.

entities.name: Blackfriars
entities.context: Mentioned in I only say there is one

facets.activity: Repeated James Burbage's sentence about the hall

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There's a great stone hall in the Blackfriars would hold a winter. I only say there is one.
